description: This script is a linter tool that analyzes Python test files to ensure they do not hardcode GPU device dependencies such as 'cuda', 'xpu', or 'mps'. It checks for functions decorated with 'requires_gpu' or 'requires_triton' and for main sections guarded by 'HAS_GPU' conditions, to prevent compatibility issues across different GPU devices.

classes.name: LintSeverity
classes.description: Enumeration for severity levels of lint messages: error, warning, advice, disabled.

classes.name: LintMessage
classes.description: Data structure representing a lint message with details such as path, line, code, severity, and description.

classes.name: DeviceBiasVisitor
classes.description: AST NodeVisitor class that inspects functions and code blocks for hardcoded device dependencies and records lint messages.

methods.name: is_main_has_gpu
methods.description: Analyzes AST to determine if the main section of the script is guarded by a HAS_GPU condition.

methods.name: check_file
methods.description: Reads and parses a Python file, runs AST analysis for device bias issues, and returns lint messages.
